message: Thanks for the words of encouragement, Michelle. And I know the deeper into this stuff I get, the more the language will seem natural to me, so I think I really need an occasional reality check, which leads me to ask: which of those paragraphs is the worst for you in terms of opaqueness (opacity?) and too-thick theory-speak? 'Cause I know I'm bridging a number of disciplines, and I'm worried that the languages might be incompatible, and I'd like this stuff to be able to be read by *somebody* (and, hell, I'd love for it to be readable enough by a lot of people that it might be able to be turned into a post-dissertation book manuscript).
